Local installation dependencies:

Node.js 24.19.0 Windows x64
https://nodejs.org/
License: NODE-LICENSE.txt (MIT and bundled third-party notices).

@resvg/resvg-js and @resvg/resvg-js-win32-x64-msvc 2.6.2
https://github.com/thx/resvg-js
Downloaded from registry.npmjs.org with SHA-512 integrity verification.
License: node_modules/@resvg/resvg-js/LICENSE (MPL-2.0).

Potrace 1.16 shared library
https://potrace.sourceforge.net/
Source: https://potrace.sourceforge.net/#downloading
This DLL was copied from the local Inkscape installation.
License: POTRACE-COPYING.txt (GPL-2.0-or-later).

Legacy dependency only: the vector converter does not load Potrace. These are
local dependencies, not an assertion of a public redistribution license for
the combined package. Preserve notices and provide corresponding source when
required by the relevant licenses if redistributing.

Active vector geometry dependency:

pathkit-wasm 1.0.0 (Google Skia PathKit)
https://www.npmjs.com/package/pathkit-wasm
https://github.com/google/skia/tree/main/modules/pathkit
License: node_modules/pathkit-wasm/LICENSE (BSD-3-Clause).
The WASM engine performs vector stroke expansion and path Boolean operations.
